theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb => exact ⟨_, hb, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, hu, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb), .red_S ..⟩
  · next ha hb =>
      cases h₂
      · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
      · exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hu⟩
      · obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb)⟩
      · next ha' hb' =>
          obtain ⟨_, x, y⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
          obtain ⟨_, u, v⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
          exact ⟨_, .par x u, .par y v⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction :=
  @fun a b c h₁ h₂ => match h₁, h₂ with
    | .refl _, h => ⟨_, h, .refl _⟩
    | .par ha hb, .refl _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | .par ha hb, .par ha' hb' =>
        match parallelReduction_diamond ha ha', parallelReduction_diamond hb hb' with
        | ⟨_, x, y⟩, ⟨_, u, v⟩ => ⟨_, .par x u, .par y v⟩
    | .par (.refl _) hb, .red_I _ => ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | .par (.refl _) _, .red_K _ _ => ⟨_, .red_K _ _, .refl _⟩
    | .par (.par (.refl _) h2) _, .red_K _ _ => ⟨_, .red_K _ _, h2⟩
    | .par (.refl _) hb, .red_S _ _ _ =>
        ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par (.refl _) hb) (.par (.refl _) hb)⟩
    | .par (.par (.refl _) i2) hb, .red_S _ _ _ =>
        ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par (.refl _) hb) (.par i2 hb)⟩
    | .par (.par (.par (.refl _) j2) i2) hb, .red_S _ _ _ =>
        ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par j2 hb) (.par i2 hb)⟩
    | .red_I _, .refl _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | .red_I _, .par (.refl _) h2 => ⟨_, h2, .red_I _⟩
    | .red_I _, .red_I _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | .red_K _ _, .refl _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    | .red_K _ _, .par (.refl _) _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    | .red_K _ _, .par (.par (.refl _) i2) _ => ⟨_, i2, .red_K _ _⟩
    | .red_K _ _, .red_K _ _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | .red_S _ _ _, .refl _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | .red_S _ _ _, .par (.refl _) h2 =>
        ⟨_, .par (.par (.refl _) h2) (.par (.refl _) h2), .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par (.refl _) i2) h2 =>
        ⟨_, .par (.par (.refl _) h2) (.par i2 h2), .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par (.par (.refl _) j2) i2) h2 =>
        ⟨_, .par (.par j2 h2) (.par i2 h2), .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | .red_S _ _ _, .red_S _ _ _ => ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a' ⬝ b'
      exact ⟨.refl (a' ⬝ b'), .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      use a₃ ⬝ b₃
      constructor
      · exact .par ha.1 hb.1
      · exact .par ha.2 hb.2
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      use b', .red_I b'
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      use a₂'
      exact ⟨.red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b'
      apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        simp_all only
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_I a₁⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      use a₁'
      exact ⟨ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      use a₁'
      exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K =>
      use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c)
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c')
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S ..
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _,⟩
